name: Paraldehyde
summary: Paraldehyde is the cyclic trimer of acetaldehyde molecules. Formally, it is a derivative of 1,3,5-trioxane, with a methyl group substituted for a hydrogen atom at each carbon. The corresponding tetramer is metaldehyde. A colourless liquid, it is sparingly soluble in water and highly soluble in ethanol. Paraldehyde slowly oxidizes in air, turning brown and producing an odour of acetic acid.

uses.text: Paraldehyde was introduced into clinical practice in the UK by the Italian physician Vincenzo Cervello (1854–1918) in 1882. It is a central nervous system depressant and was soon found to be an effective anticonvulsant, hypnotic and sedative. It was included in some cough medicines as an expectorant (though there is no known mechanism for this function beyond the placebo effect).

summaryZh: 三聚乙醛（英語：Paraldehyde）是乙醛的三聚體，化學式3，也可看作是1,3,5-三噁烷的三個H被甲基取代的衍生物。相對應的四聚體是四聚乙醛。為無色液體，微溶於熱水，能與醇、醚混溶。

pharmacology.en: It depresses the central nervous system in a general way, as other old-fashioned sedatives do. How it acts in detail is not well understood.
pharmacology.zh: 它以廣泛的方式抑制中樞神經系統，與其他舊式鎮靜劑相似，詳細作用機制至今仍不清楚。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它以广泛的方式抑制中枢神经系统，与其他旧式镇静剂相似，详细作用机制至今仍不清楚。

sideEffects.en: It irritates the stomach and the airways and can damage the liver and kidneys. On standing it decomposes to acetic acid and other products, and old stock has caused poisoning. Regular use leads to dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 它會刺激胃部與呼吸道，並可能損傷肝臟與腎臟。放置久了會分解成醋酸等產物，陳舊的存貨曾造成中毒。規律使用會造成依賴。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它会刺激胃部与呼吸道，并可能损伤肝脏与肾脏。放置久了会分解成醋酸等产物，陈旧的存货曾造成中毒。规律使用会造成依赖。

fact.en: It is three molecules of acetaldehyde joined into a ring. Introduced as a sedative in 1882, it has a sharp smell and a taste that made patients easy to spot.
fact.zh: 它由三個乙醛分子接成一個環。1882 年作為鎮靜劑問世，它氣味刺鼻、味道明顯，使用它的病人很容易被辨認出來。
fact.zhHans: 它由三个乙醛分子接成一个环。1882 年作为镇静剂问世，它气味刺鼻、味道明显，使用它的病人很容易被辨认出来。
